svg.title: How the answers are measured
svg.desc: Golden questions go through an eval run that records every model call; a judge model rules on each answer and the run is scored. The judge is checked against blind labels, the recorded run is replayed offline in CI, and a sealed set of new questions is run once for each before and after.
svg.text: a tool that changes what the
scoring rules are written down before any re-scoring,
and a question's label changes only with a record to quote
